description:
## Problem
After a tuned server-mode load, `benchbox/platforms/clickhouse/workload.py:665-684` waits for background merges to settle. It only prints the time waited (`emit` at line 684). The result records nothing, and the ADR says the wait "is not counted as load time", so readers cannot see this cost of tuning. `notuning` runs do not wait at all, so their queries may run while merges are still happening.

## Change
- Persist the `MergeSettleResult` (`settled`, `waited_seconds`, `active_parts`) and the timeout in the result as its own phase, next to `phases.post_load_maintenance`. Never fold it into `data_loading` or query time.
- Apply the wait in the modes the owner chose in D2 (`tuning-evidence-tuned-mode-promise-20261008`).
- Record a wait that times out as unsettled; it already logs a warning.

## Decision gate
- If adding the phase needs a `result_schema_version` bump, follow the result-schema policy. If the change goes beyond an additive field, stop and ask.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Keep the timeout, poll and stability constants in `merge_settle.py`.
- Local (chDB) mode is unchanged unless D2 says otherwise.
- Do not count settle time as load time unless the ADR is amended to say so.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`. Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop 5ca12e6ca.
